headword: {有給休暇|ゆうきゅうきゅうか}

definitions.gloss: paid vacation; paid leave; paid time off
definitions.explanation: Time off from work during which an employee continues to receive their regular salary. Legally mandated in Japan based on length of service.

examples.japanese: {有給休暇|ゆうきゅうきゅうか}を{取|と}って{旅行|りょこう}に{行|い}った。
examples.english: I took paid leave and went on a trip.

examples.japanese: {有給休暇|ゆうきゅうきゅうか}が{残|のこ}り{五日|いつか}ある。
examples.english: I have five days of paid vacation left.

examples.japanese: {会社|かいしゃ}が{有給休暇|ゆうきゅうきゅうか}の{取得|しゅとく}を{推奨|すいしょう}している。
examples.english: The company encourages employees to take their paid leave.

notes:
ABBREVIATIONS:
Commonly abbreviated to {有給|ゆうきゅう} or {有休|ゆうきゅう} in casual contexts.
・「{明日|あした}{有休|ゆうきゅう}{取|と}る」 - "I'm taking paid leave tomorrow"

COLLOCATIONS:
・{有給休暇|ゆうきゅうきゅうか}を{取|と}る - to take paid leave
・{有給休暇|ゆうきゅうきゅうか}を{消化|しょうか}する - to use up paid leave
・{有給休暇|ゆうきゅうきゅうか}の{申請|しんせい} - paid leave request
・{年次|ねんじ}{有給休暇|ゆうきゅうきゅうか} - annual paid leave

LEGAL CONTEXT:
Japanese labor law requires employers to provide a minimum of 10 days of paid vacation after 6 months of continuous employment, increasing with years of service. Despite legal requirements, Japan has historically had low rates of paid leave usage.
